instrument.model: double-pulse modulator + Stage A relative masking

params.name: beta
params.why: Fritz's timbre control: 0 = single pulse, 1 = antisymmetric double pulse. The whole point of the cell.

params.name: sigma_scale
params.why: ERB is an equivalent RECTANGULAR bandwidth; Stage A showed the audible count is width-sensitive

params.name: pulse_width
params.why: sets P_n, the pulse's own envelope, which multiplies BOTH parities equally and so cannot affect A1; it scales A2's absolute level, not the ratio across beta

params.name: h_max
params.why: brocot_waveform_parity showed only a stack's EXTENT moves the ringing set, so the extent is held fixed while parity content sweeps — the control this cell needs

params.name: f_c
params.why: the criterion is a ratio of amplitudes; scale-invariant

symmetric difference of ringing sets acr.name: symmetric difference of ringing sets across beta
symmetric difference of ringing sets acr.why: a symmetric difference of subsets of 90 nodes

even-harmonic level swing across beta, d.name: even-harmonic level swing across beta, dB
even-harmonic level swing across beta, d.why: a level ratio in dB; 0 if the control does nothing, and bounded well under 120 dB by the smallest nonzero beta step tested

non-degenerate ratios audible at any bet.name: non-degenerate ratios audible at any beta
non-degenerate ratios audible at any bet.why: a count of the 16 non-degenerate below-horizon ratios

distinct denominators among ringing rati.name: distinct denominators among ringing ratios
distinct denominators among ringing rati.why: a count of distinct q values present in the enumerated set

q values shared between ringing and non-.name: q values shared between ringing and non-ringing
q values shared between ringing and non-.why: a count of shared q values, 0 to the number of distinct q
